title: Magic Flash Fiction
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Wizards of the Coast short stories)

paragraphs.text: Flash Fiction is a series of very short Magic: The Gathering stories about double-faced cards , featured on The Official Magic: The Gathering Tumblr . The series was introduced by the Magic Social Team in October 2017. In the first months of 2018, Wizards started asking followers to write flash fan fiction based on an assigned cards. The cards assigned were: Protean Raider , Profane Procession , Rekindling Phoenix , Totally Lost , Master of the Wild Hunt .
